$comment: Every binary asset the modpack ships, with its licence. tools/build/asset_sets.py reads it: the build puts `files` of a set into its feature's package at `target`, with the licence and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; tools/assets/render.py makes `files` from `sources`. Regenerate THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md with `python tools/build/asset_sets.py --write`.

sets.title: Crosshair centre marks
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.contents: 4 full-colour centre marks (colorblind, triad, arcs, stack): SVG sources, RGBA PNG 64 and 128 px
sets.fair_play: A static image drawn at the client's own reticle centre; computes nothing.

sets.title: Crosshair vector centre marks in eight colours
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.contents: 19 pixel-snapped vector centre marks (chevrons, crosses, arrow, dots, rings, angles, brackets, corners, X, diamond), plain and with a 1 px dark outline: SVG sources written from the ui-web reticle-mark geometry, RGBA PNG 64 px in white, orange, lime, green, yellow, cyan, magenta and red
sets.fair_play: A static image drawn at the client's own reticle centre; computes nothing.

sets.title: Crosshair Pack 1.1 (3 of 200)
sets.author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
sets.copyright: Kenney Vleugels, dedicated to the public domain
sets.contents: crosshair-021, -113, -196 from PNG/Outline (2x) (148 px, unmodified in src/), resized to 64 and 128 px
sets.fair_play: A static image drawn at the client's own reticle centre; computes nothing.

sets.title: Sixth-sense icons
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.contents: 4 icons (lamp, eye, badge, marks): SVG sources, RGBA PNG 64 and 128 px plus a dimmed frame of each for the pulse
sets.fair_play: Shown when the client's own sixth-sense lamp lights, for the player's own vehicle.

sets.title: Damage-log kind glyphs
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.contents: 6 damage-kind glyphs (damage, radio, track, stun, blocked, received) and 5 vehicle-class glyphs (class_light, class_medium, class_heavy, class_td, class_spg): SVG sources, RGBA PNG 32 px
sets.fair_play: Decorates the player's own damage-log lines; the class glyph shows the vehicle class the player panels already show.

sets.title: BattleHits shell and hit-effect models
sets.author: Andrii Andrushchyshyn (poliroid)
sets.contents: From BattleHits 2.4.1 (commit 6ed4c2b, resources/in/content/battlehits), unmodified and at their original in-game path: the AP, APCR, HEAT and HE shell models (common/shells/ap|apcr|heat|hemodern), the four hit-effect markers of style1 (ricochet, notpenetration, penetration, critical) and their textures
sets.fair_play: Drawn only in the hangar's hit viewer after the battle, on the player's own recorded hits: the shell along its recorded path and a marker of the outcome the client showed.

sets.title: Hangar look colour grading tables
sets.author: Три отметки
sets.contents: 4 colour grading tables of our own (night, sunset, steel, studio): the grades in src/grades.json, written by tools/assets/lut.py as 256x16 BGRA8 DDS in the client's colour-table layout
sets.fair_play: Colour grading of the player's own hangar view, named by the hangar look environments the manager builds; never loaded in battle.
